derivation.onset: Day +5 ICE 9/10 is the first Grade 1 finding (section 6.2) and equals the record date. Both Day +7 readings are later, so onset is the same under every reading: 7.7.
derivation.max_grade: Two assessments about 30 minutes apart on Day +7 disagree (ICE 5 = Grade 2, ICE 8 = Grade 1). Section 6.4: both are reported, neither chosen silently. Reading A gives max grade 2 = record (7.7), reading B gives max 1 < record 2 (7.3). Different categories, so 7.5, reason conflicting assessments (section 7.5, A23).

ambiguity_notes: Reason: conflicting assessments. Reading A (ICE 5, nursing) -> documented grade 2 -> 7.7; reading B (ICE 8, physician) -> documented grade 1 -> 7.3. No competing cause, no assessment barrier, and the consciousness descriptions are all 'awake'. Day +9 'Sleeping at intervals, easily woken' is ordinary sleep, not a described depressed level of consciousness, and is not treated as a finding; if it were read as 'awakens to voice' reading B would also reach Grade 2 and the grade would become 7.7. Pre-conditioning ICE (Day -3) and the weight correction in D12 v2 are not relevant (outside window / non-clinical).
